phase_name: Isolated test suite for the freshness checker

objectives.description: Create test-deploy-freshness.sh following directory convention (set -uo pipefail, pass/fail/info helpers, PASSED/FAILED counters, mktemp -d root, trap cleanup EXIT, exit 0/1)
objectives.note: File existed as an untracked, interrupted-run artifact; inspected, found structurally sound, and completed by adding the missing info() helper for full convention compliance.

objectives.description: Build fixture: throwaway source-store git repo with committed extension subdirectory, plus throwaway consuming repo with fabricated .claude-extensions.json, real checker copied byte-for-byte
Case STALE: older recorded source_git_head -> exactly one WARN naming the extension and remedy, exit 0
Case FRESH: recorded head equals current revision -> no output, exit 0
Case MISSING FIELD: source_dir present, source_git_head absent -> no output, exit 0
Case UNVERIFIABLE: source_dir outside any git repo, and separately nonexistent path -> no output, exit 0 for each
Case SCOPING: commit outside the extension's own subdirectory -> no output (path-scoped, not whole-repo HEAD)
Register suite in manifest.json under provides.scripts alongside existing tests/ entries; confirm run-all.sh discovers it
objectives.note: run-all.sh discovers suites via test-*.sh glob, not an explicit list, so the manifest entry is deploy-registration only; discovery confirmed by direct invocation.

approaches_tried.approach: Inspected untracked test-deploy-freshness.sh left by the prior interrupted /orchestrate run rather than assuming it was junk
approaches_tried.reason: File was structurally complete and all 7 assertions passed on first run against the real checker; only the info() helper was missing for full directory-convention compliance.
